summary: Paddy Mountain tower the FFLA lists as gone, type uncertain; MountainZone maps a Paddy Mountain summit in Frederick County, a few km away.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association, which marks the structure type with a question mark.

evidence.supports: Listed as Paddy Mountain, Shenandoah / Hardy (WV), Tower?, Gone
evidence.quote: Shenandoah / Hardy (WV) Paddy Mountain 38.97389 -78.59222 Tower? Gone

evidence.supports: MountainZone summit Paddy Mountain is in Frederick County VA
Approximate elevation of that summit, 2,986 ft (910 m)

sources.title: Paddy Mountain in Frederick County VA (Wardensville Area)

notes_for_editor: Two listings only; no build date, design, staffing or fire record was found. Sources disagree on the county: FFLA gives Shenandoah / Hardy (WV) with Tower? and Gone; MountainZone gives a Paddy Mountain summit in Frederick County at 39.0067749, -78.563345. The FFLA point (38.97389, -78.59222) is about 4.4 km from that summit (computed from the two coordinates), so the lookout may not be on the MountainZone summit. No correction proposed; a human should check the FFLA point. Not used, because they are other towers with similar names: Paddy Mountain Tower Site (US 408, PA 237, Centre County PA, built 1910) and Paddy Knob (Highland County VA, US 1653, VA 46). Brief's local_unit 'Shenandoah / Hardy (WV)' matches the FFLA list.
